This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the little block.

This pump is used to transfer water from
 feed water tank
 to low pressure evaporator then to feed water tank again.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Abd Allah Saada, revised by eng. Ahmed El-Saaedy, accepted by eng. Magdey 
 Hegazy, approved by eng. Khamis Elsherif Maintenance General Manager and 
 approved by eng. Abdel Moaty Elrakayby Head Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

This 
 document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection and quality 
 control general manager & MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed 
 Nageeb: inspection and quality controls head sector.

items: A work permit must be issued.

The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet, 
 breathing mask, safety glasses.
Shutdown the pump.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.
Close the shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge).

Let the pumps cool down to about < 80 C measured at the branches, then seal 
 off the cooling water pipes and close all other supply lines.
Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling liquid, lube oil.

The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding zone of 
 work.
Complete set of tools.
Crane.
Alignment indicators, filler.
Grease gun, cleaning fluid.
Measure the alignment and record it.
Measure the vibration and record it.
Record the discharge pressure.
Disconnect the motor electrically.

Isolate the pump (Close the isolating valves) 
 and drain it as completely as possible.
Disconnect the auxiliary piping (water cooling).

Uncoupling pump from motor and disconnect any 
 safety devices as well as pressure and temperature measuring instrumentation.

Disconnect pump from suction and discharge 
 piping.
Remove coupling spacer.
Drain the oil.
Remove the casing adapter frame nuts.
Pull out the complete bearing housing with rotor.

Carry the complete bearing housing with rotor 
 eventually to the workshop to continue dismantling.
Clean all parts of the pump.
Change all the gaskets.
Change all the packing.
Change the oil.

All parts ( as bearing ) must be checked prior to 
 assembly and repaired or replaced if necessary .

Measure the radial clearance for the pump and 
 adjust them.
Inspect the run out of the shaft.

Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the little block.
This pump is used to transfer water from
 feed water tank
 to low pressure evaporator then to feed water tank again.
Technical Data:

The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Abd Allah Saada, revised by eng. Ahmed El-Saaedy, accepted by eng. Magdey 
 Hegazy, approved by eng. Khamis Elsherif Maintenance General Manager and 
 approved by eng. Abdel Moaty Elrakayby Head Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.
This

 control general manager & MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed 
 Nageeb: inspection and quality controls head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet, 
 breathing mask, safety glasses.
Shutdown the pump.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.
Close the shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge).
Let the pumps cool down to about < 80 C measured at the branches, then seal 
 off the cooling water pipes and close all other supply lines.
Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling liquid, lube oil.
The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding zone of 
 work.
Tools and Equipment
Complete set of tools.
Crane.
Alignment indicators, filler.
Grease gun, cleaning fluid.
Work to be Carried Out
Before 
Disassembly
Measure the alignment and record it.
Measure the vibration and record it.
Record the discharge pressure.
Dismantling
Disconnect the motor electrically.
Isolate the pump (Close the isolating valves) 
 and drain it as completely as possible.
Disconnect the auxiliary piping (water cooling).
Uncoupling pump from motor and disconnect any 
 safety devices as well as pressure and temperature measuring instrumentation.
Disconnect pump from suction and discharge 
 piping.
Remove coupling spacer.
Drain the oil.
Remove the casing adapter frame nuts.
Pull out the complete bearing housing with rotor.
Carry the complete bearing housing with rotor 
 eventually to the workshop to continue dismantling.
Procedures
Clean all parts of the pump.
Change all the gaskets.
Change all the packing.
Change the oil.
All parts ( as bearing ) must be checked prior to 
 assembly and repaired or replaced if necessary .
Measure the radial clearance for the pump and 
 adjust them.
Inspect the run out of the shaft.
Assembling
The pump should be assembled in the reverse order of disassembly.
After Assembly
Open the suction and delivery of the pump.
Record the alignment.
Record the discharge pressure.
Record the vibration
